_note: Copy to copilot-mcp.config.json (gitignored) and point COPILOT_MCP_CONFIG at it. copilot.profiles is the normal path (every Copilot tool takes a required profile arg). Each env of a profile picks one of TWO auth modes: (1) support-account auth — the env entry is just { clinicUid } and the credentials come from copilot.support[env]; get the clinicUid from the list_clinics tool. (2) direct per-account login — the env entry carries be/email/password, the pre-existing shape. clinicUid wins if both are present. Today only prod has adopted support accounts (see ossm below: prod = clinicUid, pre_prod = direct creds); kafri is left fully direct, which still works unchanged. copilot.support is required only for envs whose profiles use clinicUid. copilot.sessionCache (default true) persists authenticated sessions to ~/.cache/copilot-mcp/sessions.json (0600; COPILOT_MCP_CACHE overrides the path) so a restart doesn't spend a login against the support account's 10-logins-per-15-minutes budget — that file holds live JWTs, never commit it. A top-level copilot.prod/pre_prod pair is also accepted as a direct-login fallback for callers that pass no profile, but isn't needed once profiles are set. folderIdByEnv is optional (numeric OrganizationUnitId; defaults to prod 231517 / pre_prod 434039 if omitted). uipath.folderPath (singular, legacy) plus queueUrl/addQueueItemPath/serverUrlByEnv are only needed for build_queue_item. uipath needs bearer, oauth, or both — oauth (client-credentials) is tried first when present, with bearer as the fallback if the OAuth token request fails or oauth is omitted; oauth.tokenUrl is optional and otherwise guessed from orchestratorUrl. Alternatively set COPILOT_MCP_LOCAL_DIR to a dir holding the legacy split files order-copy-credentials.json + uipath-config.json. Config edits are picked up live on the next tool call — no server restart needed.

uipath.bearer: <UiPath Personal Access Token with OR.Jobs read scope> (optional if oauth is set; also used as its runtime fallback)
